bio.text: David Nelson has served in the Alaska House of Representatives for District 18 since 2025; the Legislature also lists his earlier service in 2021 to 2022.
According to his legislative biography, he was born in Orlando, Florida, moved to Anchorage in 2015, and earned a B.A. in political science from the University of Alaska Anchorage in 2018.
The biography says he served as president of the Mid-Town Rotary Club of Anchorage.
